phase: server: challenge entry authority (entitlement precedence + owned-record resume/route)
problem: A real paid challenge_39_9 owner (record CR1790632776226vtmih6: trialMode=false, unlocked=true, status=finished) was shown the ¥39.90 paywall again. Root cause: startChallenge found the owned record but rejected it with `existing.status !== 'finished'`, then fell through to create a NEW trial because hasAccess ignored product entitlement (entitlements.challenge_full) and only considered memberships.

changes.ENTITLEMENT_AUTHORITY: cloudfunctions/startChallenge/lib/challengeEntitlement.js (NEW) — hasChallengeEntitlement(db, openid) delegates to the canonical cloudfunctions/startChallenge/lib/permissionEngine.js (byte-identical copy of cloudfunctions/common/permissionEngine.js; sha256 57e42473869b3f44…) → hasPermission(db, openid, 'challenge_full'). permissionEngine reads the entitlements collection first (finalizer-written), then memberships. No second/divergent resolver.
changes.ENTRY_PRECEDENCE: cloudfunctions/startChallenge/index.js — resolve in strict order: (A/B) owned record (trialMode===false, fallback unlocked===true), newest by createdAt; if not finished → resume SAME recordId (resumed,completed=false,trialMode=false,unlocked=true); if finished → SAME recordId + completed=true + destination='challenge_result' (NO new record, NO trial); (C) no owned record but hasAccess → new record with trialMode=false (never trial); (D) only a genuinely non-entitled user gets trialMode=true. hasAccess = membership fast-path (challenge_unlock|challenge_full) OR canonical challenge_full entitlement (entitlements→memberships).
changes.RECORD_SELECTION: Owned query filters trialMode:false / unlocked:true directly (not a bare createdAt scan) → later stale trial records can never outrank the paid record.
changes.TESTS: tests/rc8.9/challenge-entry-authority.test.js (NEW, A–J + M + cross-user): unfinished paid → same id/no new; finished paid → same id completed+result/no new; paid beats newer stale trials; entitlement w/o owned → never trial; free → trial; idx>3 → no paywall gate; repeat ×5 → 0 new; membershipLevel=free + challenge_full → entitled; memberships absent → entitled; finished paid wins over stale trial. tests/rc8.9/challenge-resume-authority.test.js R5 updated to the R6 finished-route contract. Registered in tests/rc8.9/run.js.

rollbackPlan: git revert <server-commit>; redeploy startChallenge; remove lib/challengeEntitlement.js + lib/permissionEngine.js if reverting. No schema/env change.
